about_the_game:
In 2284, a single interstellar corporation exploits the resources of newly discovered planets. As one of its employees, you are tasked with establishing and managing colonies on these planets.

Compete with your peers by:

  • Expanding influence across the planet

  • Building and expanding factories

  • Gathering and managing resources

  • Trading with other players or the corporation

Each session challenges players to carefully plan ahead, respond to rival tactics, and adapt their approach to each planet accordingly.

The game features:

  • Turn-based asynchronous multiplayer

  • Room based matchmaking system

  • Hex Map Editor

  • 12 Building types

  • 6 resource types

  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or newer, or another modern 64-bit Linux distribution (e.g., Fedora, Arch)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo, AMD Athlon X2, or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: Hex Colony: 2284 is a fast-paced, hexagonal, turn-based, multiplayer strategy game set in a dystopian future. Build and expand your colony on a newly discovered planet by exploiting resources, striking trade deals and asserting dominance over the competition. Hexagons are the Bestagons!
